prompt: Perform a 2D supersonic flow simulation over a wedge. Create a 3D geometry spanning from -0.15242 m to 0.3048 m in the x-direction, 0 m to 0.1524 m in the y-direction, and -0.005 m to 0.005 m in the z-direction. The simulation starts at 0.0 seconds and runs until 0.2 seconds with a time step (deltaT) of 0.0001 seconds. The results are written every 0.02 seconds. The inlet velocity is 5 m/s, inlet temperature is 1 K and inlet pressure is 1 Pa. Use normalized thermodynamic properties where molWeight is set to 11640.3, Cp is 2.5, Pr is 1.0, and dynamic viscosity mu is 0.01. Use rhoCentralFoam solver. Use SpalartAllmaras turbulence model. The wedge surface is a slip boundary. Do not use more than 4800 cells in your mesh.
adaptation: 保留归一化气体，R明确取prompt近似值、gamma由cp/R一致导出。
不约束rhoCentralFoam、源网格数和内部时间步；本题具体湍流闭合、热力学及能量定义公开给出。
